WITH U AS( SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.DOC_NO DESC) RNUM , T.* FROM ( SELECT SD.DOC_NO, S.SANCTION_NO,DOC_CREATE_DATE, DOC_TITLE, USER_NM, DEPT_NM, DOC_TYPE_NM, SANCTION_USER , LAG(S.SANCTION_STATUS_NO) OVER(PARTITION BY SD.DOC_NO ORDER BY S.SANCTION_NO) BEF_SANCTION_STATUS_NO , SANCTION_STATUS_NO
FROM SANCTION S INNER JOIN SANCTION_DOC SD on S.DOC_NO = SD.DOC_NO INNER JOIN DOC_TYPE DT ON SD.DOC_TYPE_NO = DT. DOC_TYPE_NO INNER JOIN TB_USER TU ON SD.USER_NO = TU.USER_NO INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON S.SANCTION_USER = E.USER_NO INNER JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO ) T WHERE T.SANCTION_USER = #{userId} AND (BEF_SANCTION_STATUS_NO = 2 OR BEF_SANCTION_STATUS_NO IS NULL) AND T.SANCTION_STATUS_NO = 1 AND (T.DOC_TYPE_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR T.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR T.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

) T, EMPLOYEE E, DEPT D WHERE T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO AND E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO
